name: Sophia Aelfwine
source:
Sophia is a quiet, introverted girl with an interest in history. This brought her, together with Tetsuo, to form the Culture Research Club.

She came to Bali to look for her brother Luke, who vanished from their home in Brisbane after a number of strange occurances last Summer.
